key_facts.message: raw API path must stay within /user or the pinned workspace API
key_facts.interpretation: The MCP workspace fence rejects /file/image — it does not fall under /user or /workspaces/{workspaceId}/ paths. Cannot probe this endpoint through the current MCP tool. The fence is a security guardrail, not a Clockify routing result. No live Clockify response obtained.

promotion_evidence: Cannot probe /file/image through MCP — workspace fence blocks all paths outside /user and /workspaces/{workspaceId}/. No live Clockify response obtained. Cannot confirm 405 vs 404 vs 200 on this path. Both specs agree on path. Status remains UNCONFIRMED-AGREE.
notes: The MCP's workspace fence intentionally blocks non-workspace paths. /file/image is a global upload endpoint (not workspace-scoped) and therefore inaccessible via clockify_api_get or clockify_api_request. To probe: use a direct HTTP call to https://api.clockify.me/api/v1/file/image with X-Addon-Token header (GET → expect 405 if registered, or 404 if absent). Cannot promote without bypassing the MCP fence.
